packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
PACKET-04 - unverified image reading (first reader)

EXPOSURE / PROCEDURE NOTE
No proposed identification or earlier reading was present in my context before viewing.
I ran one directory listing of the three packet directories to learn the image file names
(this showed that packet.json exists; I did not open it). Nothing else was opened.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001.jpg, reduced overview)
Observations:
- Black-and-white (microfilm-type) photograph of an open book, upright. Metal clips hold the
  book at upper left and upper right.
- Left side: one written page, Greek minuscule, single column, about 22 lines of main text.
  No running title, no marginal or interlinear glosses seen in the overview. Many superscript
  abbreviations and suspended endings.
- Below the main text: a horizontal ornamental divider (row of small strokes/dots), then a
  two-line inscription in large display capitals, then a short line in smaller script.
- Right side: the inside of a dark, worn cover/board (or a blank pastedown); no text seen.
- Page is stained, especially at the top and along the left edge; left ends of the first lines
  are partly under the clip shadow.
Tentative interpretation: this is the last page of a text, closed by an explicit in capitals.

Overview reading of the closing inscription (image-001.jpg):
  display line 1: + ΤΕΛΟΣ ΣΥΝ Θ(ε)Ω ΤΟΥ ΚΛΙ
  display line 2: ΜΑΚΟΣ  (followed by an ornamental terminal sign)
  small line below: + [short group of letters/numerals, see tiles]
(The explicit is transcribed as written; I draw no identification from it.)

----------------------------------------------------------------------
FACE A (the page shown in overview image-001.jpg), tiles image-002.jpg and image-003.jpg
Selected: the whole main text (it is a single continuous closing passage) and the explicit.
image-002.jpg = upper part of the page (lines 1-16 of the page, plus the top of line 17).
image-003.jpg = lower part; its first four lines repeat image-002 lines 13-16 (overlap).
Accents/breathings are given as far as I can see them; many endings are suspended or
written above the line. "κ(αὶ)" = the kai-compendium.

image-002.jpg
 1: καλοῦ λοξιοδρόμ(..) [letters ιδ?/ου? above the end of the word]· σὺ δὲ ὦ [..]ω τοῦ κοι[.]δό[.] πο
 2: θεν τὴν ἄφιξιν ἐπὶ τοῦτ(ο?) τ(..)ω ὁσίαι κ[..]?· πρ(ὸς?) τ[..]   (ω written above "τοῦτ"; line end stained)
 3: τὴν ἀμυδρ(ὸν?) κ(αὶ) ὅλην(?) φλυαρί(ας?) ὀνιμα(?) ἀτραχ(..)?·   (very uncertain after "ἀμυδρ")
 4: μᾶλλον δὲ ἀνθράκων πεπληρωμένην·
 5: ἐπειδὴ δὲ οὐ κατείληφα(?) / οὐκ ἀπαλλαγῆναι(?) · τὸν μῦθον ἀ(πο?)
 6: σιωποδρόμε(?) / οἰωοδρόμε(?) τὸν τοῦ σοῦ δρόμου ἐν τῷ μὴ
 7: σου κατάληψιν(?) ἂν(?) οἴχεσθαι· πάλιν τούτ(ου?)
 8: σου καὶ ἄλλους(?) βραχυ[..]ον ἐξανύφηνον τὸν λ(ό)
 9: γον ἡμ(ῖν?) ὦ δέ(σποτα?)·  ὅτι καὶ πρὸς τ(ὸ?) λακτ[..]? τῶ ὀρθ(..)
10: τὸ λοιπ(ὸν?)· κ(αὶ) τὸ μὴ[.] καὶ(?) φ[..]σο ὃν(?) ἀνέφηνας· κ(αὶ)
11: ἐπὶ τὴν βάσιν τὸν πόδα ἐπέθηκας(?)·  κ(αὶ)
12: ἔδραμες· κ(αὶ) ηὐτόθης(?) [or ἔφθασας?]· κ(αὶ) ἐπέβης ἐπὶ χερου
13: βὶμ ἀρετῶν· καὶ ἐπετάσθης· κ(αὶ) ἀνέβης
14: ἐν ἀλαλαγμῶ· τὸν ἐχθρὸν τροπωσάμεν(ος)?
15: κ(αὶ) πρόοδο(ς?) ποιηθ(εὶς?)· κ(αὶ) προηγήσω. μᾶλλον
16: δὲ καὶ ἔτι(?) νῦν ἡγῆ πᾶσι κ(αὶ) προηγήση(?)
17: [top of line only; = image-003 line 5]

image-003.jpg
 1: [bottoms of letters only; = image-002 line 13]
 2: = image-002 line 14: ἐν ἀλαλαγμῶ· τὸν ἐχθρὸν τροπωσάμεν(ος)?
 3: = image-002 line 15: κ(αὶ) πρόοδο(ς?) ποιηθ(εὶς?)· κ(αὶ) προηγήσω. μᾶλλον
 4: = image-002 line 16: δὲ καὶ ἔτι(?) νῦν ἡγῆ πᾶσι κ(αὶ) προηγήση(?)
 5: πᾶσιν ἡμῖν(?) ἡμῶν(?) ἐπ' αὐτὴν τὴν κορυφὴν
 6: ἀναδραμὼν τῆς ὁσίας κλίμακος·
 7: καὶ ἑνωθεὶς τῆ ἀγάπη.  ἡ δὲ ἀγάπη ἐ
 8: στὶν ὁ θ(εὸ)ς·  αὐτῶ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶ(νας)   (final syllable as a raised sign)
 9:        τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν :-      (short, indented/centred last line)
10: [ornamental divider: a row of small s-shaped strokes across the page, with a hook at left]
11: + ΤΕΛΟΣ ΣΥΝ Θ(Ε)Ω ΤΟΥ ΚΛΙ     (display capitals; ΘΩ with overline; ΟΥ as ligature ȣ)
12:            ΜΑΚΟΣ ·:· [star/rosette-shaped terminal ornament]
13: [blank band with two dark blots at left]
14: + ξ(?) α(?)[overlined] γ(?) ζ(?) α(?)[overlined] :-    (short line in small script, some letters
     overlined like numerals or nomina sacra; I cannot resolve it: possibly a date or a
     numeral note. A closer crop would help.)

Notes on face A:
- Lines 1-3 and 5-10 are the least secure: the page is stained there and endings are
  suspended. Lines 4, 11-16 and image-003 lines 5-12 are comparatively clear.
- Sense visible (observation, not identification): second-person address to a person who
  "ran", "mounted on the cherubim of virtues", "flew up", "ascended with a shout", and leads
  others "to the very summit ... of the holy ladder", "united to love; and love is God; to
  him the glory unto the ages of ages, amen".
----------------------------------------------------------------------
SECOND OPENING (overview image-004.jpg), faces B (left) and C (right)
Layout survey (image-004.jpg, reduced overview):
- Same book, same clips, upright. Two facing pages, both filled edge to edge with a small,
  fast, heavily abbreviated Greek cursive in a different and much less formal hand than
  face A; long lines, single column, no ruling evident, lines wavering; roughly 25-28 lines
  on the left page and about as many on the right. No rubrics, initials, running titles
  or display script. Left page: outer (left) edge eaten away in the lower half; right
  page: lower outer corner torn off, several holes. Both pages are dark, stained and
  cockled; ink is faded to the level of the staining over most of the surface.
- Tentative interpretation: added notes on end leaves / pastedown rather than the main
  text. On the left page a horizontal crease or ruled line after about line 6 may divide
  two entries; that is not certain.

Face B, tiles image-005.jpg (upper half) and image-006.jpg (lower half; its first three
lines repeat the last three of image-005).
I examined both tiles closely. The script is legible only as isolated groups; I could not
obtain any connected ten-line span, and I prefer to leave the gaps visible.

image-005.jpg
 1: [illegible - top line in stain]
 2: [illegible] κ(αὶ) οὐκ ἐξ ἀνα(γκης?)(?) [illegible]
 3: [illegible] ... κ(αὶ) τ(ὴν) [..] ... [illegible]
 4: [illegible] ἐπιγνώσεως(?) · [..] ... προσ[..] [illegible]
 5: [illegible] ... ἀπὸ δὲ χ(..) [hole] κ(αὶ) τ(..) εφ[..]
 6: [illegible] ... [.]ισχ[..]ος· καὶ γὰρ· [illegible]
 7: [crease / horizontal line across the page]
 8: [illegible] ... ὁ λόγ(ος?)(?) [illegible]
 9: [illegible] ... ἄν(θρωπ)ον(?) ... [illegible]
10: [illegible] ... τ(ῶν) ἀν(θρώπ)ων(?) ... κ(αὶ) δε[..]
11: [illegible]
12: [illegible] ... κ(αὶ) λέγων(?) [..] κ(α)τ(ὰ) τ(ὸν?) [..] [illegible]
13: [illegible]
14: [illegible] ... μόρ(ιον?)(?) · α[..] ... [illegible]
15: [illegible] πλὴν(?) οὖν(?) ... [..]κτ[..] φ[..] π(ε)ρ(ὶ?) ὁ κ[..]ω[..]
16: [..]μ(..)ν ἀπ' αὐτ(ῶν?) [..] ... [..]λέγον(?) [..] κ(αὶ) [illegible]
17: [bottom line cut by the tile edge]

image-006.jpg
 1-3: overlap with image-005 lines 15-17; nothing further gained beyond
      "... ἀπ' αὐτ(..) ... τοῦ δὲ(?) ... ὁ κ(..)νον(?)" in line 3.
 4: [..] κ(αὶ) [..]ζ(..) τοῦ δ[..]λου(?) κ(αὶ) [..] πρὸς(?) [..]
 5: [illegible] ... ἡμῖν(?) ... [illegible]
 6: [..] λέγ(ει?)(?) ... [..]ασθεὶς(?) [..] ... κ(αὶ) [..] π[..]
 7: [illegible]
 8: [illegible] ... ἡμῶν(?) [..]νουμένη(?) [..]
 9: [illegible] πρῶτ(ον?)(?) [..] κ(αὶ) [..] ... πάλιν(?)
10: [illegible] κ(αὶ) [..] π(ε)ρ(ὶ) τ(..) [..] ... [illegible]
11-13: [illegible - faint traces only]
Left ends of lines 4-13 are lost with the damaged outer edge.

Face C, tile image-007.jpg (upper half of the right-hand page)
 1-2: [illegible - stained]
 3: [illegible] ... [..]ην(?) πρ(ὸς?) [illegible]
 4: [illegible] π(ε)ρ(ὶ) τ(..) κ[..] ὁ δοῦλο(ς?)(?) κ(αὶ) [illegible]
 5: [illegible] ... ὡς τ(..) [illegible]
 6: [illegible]
 7: [crease] [illegible]
 8: [illegible]
 9: [..] θ(εο)ῦ(?) ... [illegible]
10: [illegible] ... κ(αὶ) [hole]
11: [illegible] πρὸς ὧν(?) ... [illegible]
12: [illegible] ὅλο(ν?) κ(αὶ) [..]ορ[..] ... [illegible]
13: [illegible]
14: [..] τοῦ οὖν(?) πλ(..) [illegible]
15: [illegible]
16: [illegible] ... δ(ὲ) τ(..) ἐν [..] ... λέγον(?) [..]

Face C, tile image-008.jpg (lower half of the right-hand page; its first two lines repeat
the last two of image-007). Right ends of lines 5-13 are lost with the torn corner.
 1: [..] δ(ὲ) [..] τοῦ οὖν(?) πλ(..) [illegible]            (= image-007 line 14)
 2: [illegible] ... δ(ὲ) τ(..) ἐν [..] ... λέγον(?) [..]      (= image-007 line 16)
 3: [illegible] ... τ(οῦ) λόγου(?) [..] ... [..]ζα[..] πατρῶν(?)/π(ατέ)ρων(?)
 4: [illegible] ... κ(αὶ) αὐτ(ὸς?) π[..] ... [overlined group] [illegible]
 5: [illegible] ... [several raised abbreviation strokes] ... [..]σι[..] [illegible]
 6: [illegible] ... κ(αὶ) τ(ὴν?) [..] ... [illegible]
 7: [..] κ(αὶ) [..]λ[..] ... [illegible]
 8: [illegible] ... λόγ(ον?)(?) [..] ... [illegible]
 9: [illegible] ... ταύτ(ην?)(?) ἀπὸ(?) [..]ου[..] [illegible]
10: [illegible] ... [overlined/underlined group] ... π(ε)ρ(ὶ?) [..] [illegible]
11: [bottom traces only]

----------------------------------------------------------------------
THIRD OPENING (overview image-009.jpg), face D (right-hand page)
Layout survey (image-009.jpg, reduced overview):
- Left: bare wooden board of the binding with lacing holes, cords/thread tufts at the spine
  and a zig-zag of thread; no writing seen on it.
- Right: a parchment leaf (pronounced follicle pattern, so probably a hair side; upper outer
  corner folded, outer edge ragged in the upper half) carrying two layers of writing:
  (a) very large, clumsy single letters and signs scattered in about seven rough rows over
      the whole page - they look like pen trials or a writing exercise, not text;
  (b) underneath and between them, in the middle of the page, about six short lines of a
      small, faded minuscule, most of it rubbed away; one more small line lower down.
- No columns, rubric or running title. Which layer is earlier I cannot tell from the image.

Tiles: image-011.jpg = upper two thirds of face D; image-010.jpg = lower two thirds
(they overlap in the row beginning with a large cross and in the small-script lines).

(a) Large letters, row by row (image-011.jpg, top to bottom):
 row 1: α(?)  β  γ            (small "α"-like sign, tall looped β, angular Γ)
 row 2: + (faint cross at far left)  ς/ϛ(?)  η  θ  ι  κ   [small faint group at right edge]
 row 3: μ(?) [two short strokes]  μ/ν(?)  ζ/ξ(?) (tall zig-zag letter)  ο/θ (large circle)  π(?)
 row 4: σ  τ  [large looped sign, υ/λ-like]  ρ/φ(?) (tall letter with loop at top)
 row 5: + (large cross with curved arms)  [large round letter, ο/σ/ω-like, with a long tail]
 (image-010.jpg, continuing; its row 1 = row 5 above)
 row 6: + (large cross)  ω  ο/ω(?)  β(?)  ψ/+(?)  ι
 row 7: λ  α/δ(?)  φ  [.]  ψ(?)  [.]
 row 8: κ/η(?)  σ  θ (large, with cross-bar)  ρ(?)  ι
 row 9: [faint large strokes at the foot of the page]
 Rows 1-4 read as an alphabet sequence in order with gaps (α β γ ... η θ ι κ ... μ ... ο π ...
 σ τ υ ...); that ordering is my inference from the letter shapes.

(b) Small script, middle of the page (image-010.jpg lines counted among the small lines only;
    the same lines appear at the foot of image-011.jpg):
 1: [illegible] ... [..]αρ[..]     (traces of about three words)
 2: [illegible] ... [..]ιος(?) [..]
 3: [..]ατο(?) ... ω[..]η[..] [illegible]
 4: [illegible] ... ἀλλ(?) [..]
 5: ὅρκου(?)/ὁ ὅρος(?) οὐ(..) [illegible]
 6: [two or three letters with a mark above, centred]
 lower, between large rows 7 and 8:  [..] φιλ[..]κα(?) [..]   (one short line, slightly larger)
I could not obtain connected text from this layer; it is too rubbed in these tiles.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECTED / UNREAD
- Read in full (with uncertainties marked): face A, all 21 text lines plus the explicit.
- Read only as isolated fragments: faces B and C (cursive notes) and the small script on
  face D. These remain essentially unread; I looked at every tile at full size and the
  gaps there reflect faded, stained cursive that I cannot resolve rather than choice.
- The right-hand side of image-001 (inner cover) and the board in image-009 carry no text
  that I can see.

SUGGESTIONS
- Face A: a tighter, higher-contrast crop of lines 1-3 and 5-10 and of the small line under
  the explicit.
- Faces B/C: a different exposure (or UV/colour image) of the two note pages; and a crop of
  the first lines of each, where an entry opening would be expected.
- Face D: a crop of the six small lines in the centre.

LIMITATIONS
- Black-and-white film images; stains and ink cannot always be told apart.
- Clip shadow at upper left of face A; edge losses on faces B, C and D.
- Word division, accents and all expansions in parentheses are mine; question marks mark
  readings I would not rely on. Alternatives separated by "/" are both open.
- The order of the three openings within the book is not shown by the images.
- This is an unverified image reading.
